context:
Goal: q_max sessions never touch Neon (owner, 12:04 CST, in runner 9's chat).
Problem (risk): at 11:56 CST, someone added a VERIFY_DATABASE_URL that points at a Neon host to the q_max cloud environment (env_01RGfPzEB3iusXZwCZw5q5or). A session that runs `npm run verify:browser` and does not override it writes test data into that Neon database.
Based on (read): runner 9's report, 12:05 CST.
Departs from: the cloud env sets VERIFY_DATABASE_URL to Neon today — the env drops it, or points it at local Postgres.
Meanwhile: every lane passes a local VERIFY_DATABASE_URL on each browser run.
reply: Done by you at 12:07 CST: you removed VERIFY_DATABASE_URL from the q_max cloud environment (said in runner 9's chat). DATABASE_URL, also a Neon host, is still set; if a lane finds a cloud path that uses it, it comes back as a question. Closed 12:17 CST.
short: q_max cloud env: remove the Neon setting
steps: Open claude.ai/code and go to the environment settings for env_01RGfPzEB3iusXZwCZw5q5or.
Delete the variable VERIFY_DATABASE_URL, or set it to postgresql://postgres@localhost:5432/postgres.
title: Remove VERIFY_DATABASE_URL from the q_max cloud environment
why: Your 12:04 CST ruling says q_max sessions never touch Neon. The cloud environment now sends browser checks there by default.
